name: PENGWIN 2026 peripelvic fracture CT (the public cases)
what: PENGWIN 2026, peripelvic fracture CT, 340 public cases, Zenodo record 19732767 published 2026-04-24; tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: all four parts fetched, 340 CTs in MHA, 308 once the 32 that duplicate CTPelvic1K's clinical subset are folded, about 19.57 GB in the catalogue
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder

segmentations.masks: masks of the pelvic fracture fragments, the release's own
vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh zenodo --collection pengwin2026 --record 19732767 --include '^PENGWIN26_task1_2_train_part[1-4]\.zip$', submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and, by the manifest's note, 4 zips by md5 and 340 image.mha to verify.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid pengwin2026; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="pengwin2026",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
